generator_assessments.assessment: The patient's left breast lump was diagnosed as infiltrative ductal carcinoma based on cytology and biopsy results.

raw_support_spans.text: Fine-needle aspiration cytology of the left breast lump revealed poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli; myoepithelial cells and bare nuclei were absent.
A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma that was estrogen- and progesterone-receptor positive.

generator_assessments.assessment: The patient's right breast lump was suspected to be a fibroadenoma based on physical examination and cytology results.

raw_support_spans.text: FNAC of the right breast lump showed three-dimensional clusters of hyperchromatic cells with prominent nucleoli and scattered pleomorphic cells with mitotic figures admixed with benign ductal cells and myoepithelial cells; a few bare nuclei were seen.
On the basis of the physical examination results, the right breast lump was suspected to be a fibroadenoma.
